name: Konfhub Integration
description: Integrate with the Konfhub event platform to update users.
project_description:
The KonfHub Integration module for Drupal makes it easier to handle ticket booking details by including a webhook listener for KonfHub POST events, which integrates smoothly into your Drupal site to store and manage ticket information conveniently.

 Features 
 The KonfHub Ticket Details module provides robust functionality for managing ticket details. Unique features include:

- Webhook Listener : Listens to POST events from KonfHub to automatically receive and process ticket details.

- Views Integration : Integrates with Views for creating custom ticket data reports and views.
